verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email documents an API that can be driven headlessly. It supports scoped API keys (per-resource permissions, optional expiration) and programmatic management of contacts, lists, campaign setup and report retrieval, which a CI or automation job could use. However, the docs suggest sending still happens in the UI: you duplicate a campaign via the API, then open it in Benchmark to edit and send. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: end-to-end headless campaign sending, a CLI or documented CI usage, a machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Set up the campaign name, subject line, sender details, and recipient list via the API.
Create, rename, duplicate, merge, and delete lists from another system.
Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
Optional expiration dates per key; deactivate and reactivate without rotating
Pull campaign results into your BI tool, your weekly digest, or whatever dashboard you actually look at.
